title: Customer test report, 28 September 2026 — what is fixed
source: Customer test report of the Rahti staging deployment, 28 September 2026. Findings are referenced by the report's own numbering: 1–22 from the manual session, R1–R9 from the independent AI retest, T1–T9 from the technical section.
note: Status is what the evidence shows, not what was intended. 'fixed' means at least one named test fails if the finding returns. 'open' means no fix has shipped. Sprint 4 work is listed separately and is not late.

findings.text: Approval gates are not enforced by the server; the status is only computed in the browser

evidence.name: the API refuses a step that would pass an unapproved gate

findings.text: Typing "yes" in the chat passes Gate 1 while the screen still waits for the approval button

evidence.name: the API refuses a step that would pass an unapproved gate

findings.text: The chat runs through Gates 2 and 3 while the screen stays at step 3 of 13

evidence.name: a single jump cannot skip several gates at once

findings.text: Going back cancels the Gate 1 approval already given

evidence.name: keeps an approval the user already gave when they step back below it
going back keeps the approval and the way forward

findings.text: After going back in a finished session, "Next step" is blocked with "Answer the wizard's questions in the chat first"
findings.openBecause: A different mechanism from the gates — the chat-driven advance in the early steps. Needs its own investigation.

findings.text: The UI language is never sent to the AI agent

evidence.name: passes the UI locale to the agent

findings.text: Finnish and English are mixed in Gate 1, the blueprint and Gate 2
The bot answered in Italian

evidence.name: passes the UI locale to the agent

findings.text: The English UI shows Finnish-only labels on the field list
The download is offered as soon as any file exists; the package has no README and no requirements.txt

evidence.name: an incomplete package is listed but not downloadable

findings.text: The package can be generated at Gate 2, before anything is approved

evidence.name: generation is refused until Gate 2 is approved

findings.text: "Run PoC again" does not run anything, it only regenerates the same package

evidence.name: the button says what it does, and it is not 'run'

findings.text: Invoice lines are stored as one text field; dates and amounts as plain text
findings.caveat: The wizard now generates and consumes the nested shape. Whether the agent produces it in a live session depends on the SKILL.md instruction added with it, which cannot be verified without the live agent.

findings.text: Errors are hidden and not logged; the agent service has no logging at all

evidence.name: chat route logs warn on non-ok and error on throw; agent service error paths log

findings.caveat: Logging is in place. The chat still substitutes a canned reply when the agent fails, so the user is shown an answer the assistant never wrote — see the open row below.

findings.text: When the agent fails, the chat presents a canned mock reply as the assistant's answer
findings.openBecause: Removing the fallback changes a contract that two passing tests assert. It is a decision, not a defect fix.

findings.text: The bot freezes for up to 2–3 minutes with no sign that it is working
The code running on Rahti is not in the repository; web and api ran different versions

evidence.name: deploy.sh refuses a dirty tree and a HEAD on no remote branch; verified in all three states

findings.caveat: The version is also shown in the login footer, and both halves of the current deployment now resolve to commits in this repository.

findings.text: Automated end-to-end tests are skipped by default, and the nightly acceptance run is on a branch where it never fires

evidence.name: wizard-v2-acceptance.yml now also triggers on push to dev, which is evaluated from the branch the file is on

findings.caveat: The first run of these specs found a regression that had been merged unnoticed, which is the point of the change.

groups.name: Internal terms shown to the user

findings.text: "Export to Excel" is marked as an AI step in the workflow
The agent's instructions tell it to show internal module names, Python types and raw JSON
Component names, Python types and diagram code appear in the chat
Internal values such as accounts_payable are shown on the review screen, and four assumptions cannot be confirmed anywhere
Developer and placeholder texts are shown to users
Production uses the developer login; two accounts with hard-coded passwords are in the repository
The agent runs with full permissions including shell commands, driven directly by user chat input
The screen does not follow the conversation; the requirements counter stays at 0 / 0
findings.openBecause: The agent writes nothing to disk before Phase 3, so there is nothing for the workspace to follow during gathering. Closing it is a design decision, not a defect fix.

findings.text: A change agreed in the chat does not reach the review screen
findings.openBecause: The sync runs every turn and reads the draft live, so the evidence points at the agent not rewriting its artifact. Needs a live session to confirm.

groups.name: Out of scope by agreement (7 September)

findings.text: Options offered by the bot are not clickable
Too many questions; the conversation is too heavy
Icons, filler text, layout shifts, gate timeline width
The chat panel should be resizable
Error tracking integration
The generated PoC has no Excel output
Running the PoC, providing its input, following the logs, refining after a run, downloading a deployable package
